articles.title: Justice Surya Kant appointed as the 53rd Chief Justice of India
articles.description: The President of India appointed Justice Surya Kant as the 53rd Chief Justice of India, succeeding Justice Sanjiv Khanna. He will serve a tenure until February 2027.

articles.title: RBI Monetary Policy Committee keeps Repo Rate unchanged at 6.50%
articles.description: The RBI MPC voted unanimously to keep the policy repo rate steady at 6.50% for the ninth consecutive meeting to balance inflation targets with GDP growth.

articles.title: India climbs to 82nd position in Henley Passport Index 2026
articles.description: India improved its rank to 82nd globally, offering visa-free or visa-on-arrival access to 58 destinations. Singapore retained the top rank.

articles.title: Carlos Alcaraz defeats Jannik Sinner to win 2026 Cincinnati Masters
articles.description: Carlos Alcaraz claimed the Cincinnati Masters ATP 1000 title in straight sets, securing his third Masters title of the 2026 season.

articles.title: Government expands PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana rooftop solar coverage
articles.description: The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy announced that the PM Surya Ghar scheme has crossed 1 crore household registrations, providing up to 300 units of free power per month.
